jobs.occupation: Data Functional Analyst – SQL Server & Power BI
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead discussions with business subject matter experts to identify and understand data-related needs and business processes.
• Translate business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications for data flows and solutions.
• Design and validate conceptual and logical data models in close collaboration with data architects.
• Develop functional designs for business intelligence developments in alignment with data governance and technical leads.
• Liaise with data protection officers to ensure all solutions comply with GDPR and security standards.
• Coordinate the testing of data products and facilitate user training to encourage adoption.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience in data functional analysis and data warehouse modelling using the Kimball approach.
• You possess 3+ years of experience with the Microsoft on-premise stack, specifically SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, and Power BI.
• You have a proven track record in analyzing and designing complex operational and analytics data flows.
• You're able to demonstrate strong data literacy and a conceptual understanding of business processes.
• You bring a proactive, can-do attitude with a strong sense of ownership and autonomy.
• You possess excellent problem-solving skills and a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset.
• You have professional communication and presentation skills.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Prior experience working as a data engineer.
• Experience with Azure Databricks.

Responsibilities

• Model business processes and guide stakeholders through the redesign of operational workflows.
• Identify business needs and translate them into structured requirements, such as epics and user stories.
• Bridge the gap between business users and IT partners by challenging requirements and validating functional analyses.
• Harmonize business processes across different departments and international sister organizations.
• Oversee the testing and validation of new software releases post-implementation.
• Support change management by developing training materials and conducting sessions for end-users.

Requirements

• You have a Master’s degree in a technical or economic field or equivalent through experience.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in business analysis, requirement elicitation, and process modeling.
• You possess advanced knowledge of BPMN and UML.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and the ability to challenge stakeholders to reach a consensus.
• You're proficient in planning and organizational management within complex project environments.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) or a willingness to learn.
• Knowledge of tools such as Enterprise Architect, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
• Professional background in the electricity sector or industrial asset maintenance.

Responsibilities

• Assess the quality of documentation and implementation evidence provided by internal domains based on security guidance.
• Validate that provided evidence supports self-evaluation scores and is not based on assumptions.
• Provide structured feedback and concrete improvement points to domain owners.
• Build comprehensive audit dossiers and evidence registers for external verification.
• Interpret technical evidence including configuration exports, log files, tickets, and scan reports.
• Support the organization in achieving and maintaining required security maturity levels.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in information security, compliance, or IT audit.
• You possess deep knowledge of security frameworks such as CyFun, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF.
• You bring experience in a second-line security role focusing on validation and oversight.
• You're able to analyze technical data like logs, vulnerability scans, and system configurations.
• You are native in Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with CyFun implementations specifically for essential organizations.
• Knowledge of English.

jobs.description:

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

jobs.occupation: iDSB - International German School Brussels - Head of IT Coordination & Administration
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to ensure the daily operation, proper maintenance and development of information and communication systems in order to support a high-quality edcuation and an efficient administration of the school. This role becomes more important over time. A high quality IT infrastructure and very good user experience are distinction criteria for the school and therefore a leverage to reach our strategic long term objectives.

The position holder on the one hand needs to be capable of supporting the school staff with a clientoriented mindset on all IT related issues. On the other hand she/he needs to proactively advise on improvements of the IT Infrastructure, support the decision making process and implement such new solutions.
Your tasks (list is not exhaustive)

• Responsible for the daily operation of the School's Information- and Communication Infrastructure

• Maintenance of all Hard- and Software components used in the school (Server, Antivirus, Backups, wired and wireless networks, Firewalls, video conference equipment, endpoints, telephony).

• Ensure the security of all IT systems (apply security patches, manage configurations, ensure Anti-virus and other security updates)

• Ensure all required IT services are available during school hours (7:30 - 17:30) and on request also outside school hours through pro-active maintenance and SWIFT and effective troubleshooting

• Manage the school provided Mobile devices (laptops, tablets, smartphones, mobile phones)

• Management of Contracts: Software Licenses, Maintenance agreements, IT related leasing

• Installation of new systems (including testing, appropriate communication, training etc.)

• Assure connection to external specialists and leverage them as appropriate for the school

• User access Management (including setting up accounts for new users etc.)

• Creation and maintenance of complete documentation of all ICT systems (e.g. network structure, security architecture, overview of servers in operation, network components, end devices such as PCs, tablets, projectors, smartboards, monitors, ...)

• Proactively advise on system changes or new products, which could improve the IT landscape of the school, both in the area of software as well as Hardware

• Monitor and actively advise on developments in the educational environment (Germany, Belgium) as far as Technology in schools is concerned

• Act as an advisor on general IT topics for the school's headmaster and the administrative board

Organization / exposure

• The jobholder reports to the Head of Administration of the School.

• The position is complemented by a junior IT expert, who would report to the jobholder.

• Day-to-day contact with Teachers, administrative staff and students. Occasional contact with external stakeholders (Parents, Administration Board).

• Motivated IT allrounder with 3-5 years relevant experience

• Expertise in providing 1st Level support for a small to medium organization

• Expertise in Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows 10 and network technology

• Experience with selection and implementation of new hard- or software.

• Able to communicate with partners with limited IT background when proposing new solutions or changes to existing solutions

• Ideally some project management experience

• Proactivity - you find issues before they find you, eager to push things forward

• Problem Solving Skills

• Hands-on activities are your thing

• Client oriented mindset; self-organized but also a teamplayer

• Ability to prioritise; Adherence to deadlines

• Languages: solid knowledge of English; basic German; French and / or Dutch desirable but not mandatory

Our client is looking for a Rail Transportation & Logistics Coordinator to ensure the smooth execution of rail transportation activities across Europe. This position offers a unique mix of operational coordination, issue resolution, and performance monitoring within a fast-paced international environment.

 

 

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a global market leader operating within complex international supply chains. From a strategic logistics hub in Belgium, the company manages large-scale transportation flows across Europe and continues to invest in the growth of its rail logistics operations.

 

 

 

Omschrijving

• Coordinate and monitor daily rail transportation activities across Europe.
• Manage transport disruptions, delays, and operational escalations.
• Act as the main point of contact between internal stakeholders and external transport partners.
• Monitor wagon availability, utilization, and transport capacity.
• Support sourcing of additional transport capacity when required.
• Prepare operational reports and track logistics KPIs.
• Follow up transport costs, documentation, and invoicing processes.
 

 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Initial experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or a related field is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data and Excel.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable operating in a dynamic international environment.
• Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Drive business growth in the German market by identifying new opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and managing the full sales cycle. Commercial experience is a plus, not a must: motivated juniors with strong German and English skills are welcome to apply for this 100% on-site role in Antwerp.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.

This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

 

Omschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.

Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.

 

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.
